title: Where the Mountain Remembers
summary: Xuthar and Carro explore Excavation Site, defeat Saltspine, Shadetooth and the Relic Guardian, and return past the fossil cliffs and Explorers’ League refuge.
confirmed: The supplied sequence shows Saltspine and Shadetooth defeated.
The fallen stone guardian and the companions beside it appear at 16:38:03 and 16:38:42.
The fossil excavation, high ledge, bridge and Explorers’ League cave follow in capture order.
unreported: Exact encounter start and kill times
A new level after the earlier level-25 record

photos.title: A friend at the expedition camp
photos.alt: Xuthar meets Sergeant Carro Steelcave and Broken Tooth beside the expedition tents.

photos.title: The torchlit passage
photos.alt: Xuthar follows a dark stone passage lit by two braziers.

photos.title: The valley beyond the threshold
photos.alt: A misty valley opens beyond the cobbled rise and low wooden fences.

photos.title: The marsh before the first battle
photos.alt: Turtles and marsh wildlife occupy the shaded ground beside the water.

photos.title: Carro on the wetland path
photos.alt: Carro and his companions advance between the dark water and the wooded slope.

photos.title: Water beneath the great trees
photos.alt: The path descends toward a broad pool among rocks and spreading trees.

photos.title: The broken crossing
photos.alt: Xuthar crosses the pool among floating wooden planks and marsh creatures.

photos.title: Saltspine defeated
photos.alt: Saltspine lies motionless in the pool, with Xuthar and Carro nearby.

photos.title: Shadetooth defeated
photos.alt: Shadetooth and other raptors lie on the narrow path through the tall grass; Carro and Broken Tooth stand beside Xuthar.

photos.title: The fire in the excavation camp
photos.alt: Dragonmaw enemies and a captive fire elemental stand around a burning camp beneath great fossil bones.

photos.title: Fire beneath the fossil skull
photos.alt: A huge fossil skull overlooks the tents, fires and disturbed excavation.

photos.title: The timber platform
photos.alt: Xuthar approaches wooden platforms and the guarded route beyond the camp.

photos.title: The ravine of torches
photos.alt: The expedition advances along a narrow passage between high earthen walls.

photos.title: Before the stone guardian
photos.alt: A towering stone construct waits among the expedition tents and timberwork.

photos.title: The Relic Guardian fallen
photos.alt: The great stone construct lies defeated across broken timber while Xuthar, Carro and their companions regroup.

photos.title: Honour to the companions
photos.alt: Xuthar Morvayne, Sergeant Carro Steelcave and Broken Tooth stand together beside the fallen Relic Guardian.

photos.title: The road after the battle
photos.alt: The companions follow the cobbled path away from the guardian’s clearing.

photos.title: The mountain opened like a book
photos.alt: A vast terraced excavation reveals fossils, timber supports and hanging equipment in the cliff face.

photos.title: Two friends above the ages
photos.alt: Xuthar and Carro pause on a high grassy ledge above the mist-filled Wetlands.

photos.title: The bridge above the dig
photos.alt: Carro and Broken Tooth lead the way across a wooden bridge beside the exposed fossil layers.

photos.title: The Explorers’ League refuge
photos.alt: Xuthar and Carro reach a cave with Merrik Rockweaver and another Explorers’ League member.

photos.title: The living world beyond the stone
photos.alt: The final photograph returns to an open wetland path, with trees, fences and wildlife in the afternoon light.
